name: todo-skill
description: A guided, local Markdown todo skill for AI agents.

scripts.build: esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22.12 --format=esm --outfile=skills/todo/scripts/todo.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm test
